name: Open Natural Turn
notes: Owner's figure: three flat counts from promenade after Promenade Chassé, lead right / left / right and follow left / right / left, closing into the original offset closed hold. Provisional rework for the owner's subjective review (2026-11-18): the lead's opening foot travels 65 cm along the line and 14 cm inward, on a shallow arc departing 20 degrees left of the initial body facing. It points along travel (270 degrees), keeping the knee out of the passing channel. His pelvis moves 4 cm along floor +x and 4 cm inward; the follow's moves 8 cm along -x and 4 cm inward. Their pelvis rods come within about 1.3 cm during the passage. The lead starts the body turn with 5 degrees on count 1 (facing 320), completes another 100 degrees on count 2 (facing 60) and 30 on the close (facing 90). Delaying most rotation until after the inner leg passes prevents the thighs crossing. The follow retains her original turns (255, 240, 270), widened first landing and subsequent landings. The lead's count-2 offset and arc departure compensate for his changed facing, preserving that landing exactly. Count 2 retains the follow's 4 cm floor +y body displacement; all body offsets return to zero on the close. The original entry and closed exit, count-2 outer-foot landings, foot order, weights, three-count timing and flat rise remain. No change to the preceding chassé, figure format, shared solver or diagnostic limits. No cross flag or check exemptions: dense linear/eased regression tests cover full footprints and all mannequin thigh/shin capsule pairs for the whole figure, including the opening. The default mannequin capsules have over 1 cm clearance, hip lowering stays under 13 cm, and lateral balance passes. These dimensions and redistributed turn timing are a modelling proposal, not a syllabus transcription.
